Planet Of The Apps/ Is There An App 4 That?

By: Mark Vuyisile | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Have Apps become our hands and feet in living our daily lives?

Summary:
MobileApps have come a long way from just being fun games to download onto your mobile device to meaningful, information generating and sometimes life changing Apps to have. It’s the future of doing business and as Apps change our daily lives and make things easier to achieve with just a push of a button, have we all become prisoners to our Mobile Apps? As South African Developers find a market for proudly SA mobile Apps!

Further information:
The way this story will be told will be through the eyes of the Presenter who will be using some of these Apps in the segment. A proudly South African App Developer will explain the counties App development and the challenges they encounter together with the reasons for getting into such an expensive industry. The experts will be explaining the nature of the App industry and what it takes to develop an App at what costs and how the SA market fares against the international one, with specific stats on most downloaded South African Apps together with cell phone usage verses Smartphone’s and data cost. Visually we look at showing a Vendor whom uses the Snap Scan App system in their business and how it affects how they exchange money for goods. Included will be top ten most used Apps globally and how people have become so dependent on Mobil Apps with the presenter rating in her opinion which Apps worked best for her.

Press Release:


Planet of the Apps
If you’ve thought about it, there’s probably already an app for it. Mobile apps, an integral part of our daily lives, represent the present and future of business, shopping, dating and messaging. Carte Blanche explores the international and home-grown apps filling the gaps in our lives.


Script:


VO
The way we communicate and share stories with our loved ones has come a long way from dialing someone hoping they will be home to being able to connect with someone anywhere at a touch of an icon.
The Mobile App world has become a saturated universe with millions of Apps that can do just about anything. If you can think it there’s probably an App for it.

UPSOUND Dion
It’s completely revolutionized the way we use things on what I call our precious’s, our smart phones we use every day you want it now you don’t want to have to go to a website to access this.

VO
WeChat, Instagram, Travel Apps like Google translate and Voice Map all form part of a lucrative industry.
UPSOUND Jarred Cinman
The real thing that’s changed the way we live our lives is the device that they run on so the fact that we have a computer with us 24 hours a day in most cases I think that’s the real revolution.

VO (Skit)
Imagine Mobile Apps taking over your life, to the point where you’d need a helping hand to do even the most mundane task.

LINK
Have we become so dependent on Apps that we can’t even do our normal daily chores and errands, have Apps become our hands and feet?

VO
As consumers of a wide range of content we have become accustomed to instant gratification and Apps on Smartphone’s give us this at our finger tips. Dion Chang, a trends Analyst at Flux Trends says this is the future of doing business.

UPSOUND Dion Chang
It’s just a more direct way of doing things instantaneously, so it’s part of the growing on demand economy

VOX POPS
• The App that I really have fallen in love with right now is SnapChat. What I really like about SnapChat is that there’s no branded content on it, so brands can’t push in my face all the time.
• SoundCloud cause I’m a DJ so I’m always catching up with the latest sounds. I like HypeBeast because it just helps me connect with the latest brands from a fashion point of view and Insta cause I really, really like taking pictures.

UPSOUND Dion Chang:
Theres just Apps for absolutely everything!!!

VO
Since 5am this morning I have been able to do a number of things via Mobile Apps like getting my social media updates, checking the weather& News reports, booking a cab and now buying a pair of stylish shoes. Later I think I’ll check what flights are on special…

LINK
But the question remains what is it about an App that makes it great? Can be done at the Native VML premises

VO
Jarred Cinman MD at Native VML, a pioneer in the South African digital industry explains the importance of branding and marketing an app.

UPSOUND Jarred Cinman
The most popular Apps in the world a lot of them are things that have been released by platforms or businesses that are already very popular. The best apps have solid product teams they market themselves very well they promote themselves very well it rarely happens by accident.

UPSOUND Dion Chang
I think what makes a great app is just ease of use so for me one of the future careers and the new skills of a new world order is user experience and that is exactly apps.

UPSOUND Jarred Cinman
The Cellular networks are not making the money they used to on telephony their next big money opportunity is for people to use data on their phones and key to that is Apps.

LINK
In trying to unlock the vast industry of Mobile Apps we’re starting to see Local developers create apps for our unique South African needs.

VO
Stokvels are an informal traditional method of saving in which members contribute a fixed amount of money to a common pool weekly, fortnightly or monthly. And the funds are used as per the needs of the individual or group.
Soweto born entrepreneur Tshepo Moloi developed the ideal App for this particular market.

UPSOUND Tshepo Moloi
The app is an opportunity for stokvels to pursue their financial freedom, that’s how we look at it you know. We trying to build a platform that allows any stockvel to actually access open markets, but first of cause to understand themselves.

UPSOUND Marry-Jane
Its bookkeeping made easy because prior to that you know we were like any other social group or Stokvel, where you’d have your books for contributions, you’d have your books for penalties.

VO
Abed Tau and Dylan Hyslop co-developers of TutaMe identified a need to match people looking for Tutoring services, from Maths and Science to recreational lessons. But not without some challenges.

UPSOUND Dylan Hyslop
Every entrepreneur has 20 ideas the tricky part is taking those 20 and having an honest look at them and saying which one of these is really a problem and which one do we throw all our effort, time and money behind. Importance of knowing the market and using funding wisely to get noticed.

UPSOUND Abed Tau
The real challenge with app development is that, you have to get it out there and unfortunately as creative as you can be there’s still attachment to money in terms of how you get it out there.

LINK
With South Africa having the most expensive Data and Smartphone users not buying enough data for their Apps, we’re still in the infancy of the App revolution that has changed the way businesses work, communities connect and how relationships are built.

VO
The high cost of data in South Africa is directly linked to the number of Smartphone users, but how will Smartphone’s and Apps shape the industry going forward? Greg Lynch Director of Three Sixty Digital agrees that data costs are a limiting factor.

UPSOUND Greg Lynch
Less than 50% of the population owns a smartphone, which is pretty much the most important thing when it comes to using an app. The majority of the population doesn’t really have the data to invest in downloading lots of apps. If you are an App developer in South Africa you are facing some large challenges because people in South Africa are a little bit behind the curve on average compared to global trends, but that changes rapidly and your business models have to be tighter.

VOX POP
•Apps that I can’t live without is of cause Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and I’ve just recently downloaded Snap Chat and Periscope and also with our busy life styles that we lead its always awesome to have something like a Meditation App in the palm of your hand where after a bath or a long day you can lay on your bed or on the floor and meditate for as long as you want, and I also have some recipe Apps and my phone is like has everything I need! Explaining the Apps that they can’t live without and why…



PROMOS 3
10 SECS
• Mobile Apps have become an integral part of our world; we take a look at some of the South African developed Apps that are filling the gaps in our lives.


15 SECS
• From online shopping and booking a cab to meeting your soul mate, there’s nothing we can’t do on mobile apps.
UPSOUND DION CHANG 28:43:23
It’s completely revolutionized the way we use things, it’s just a more direct was of doing things instantaneously.

• Smartphone’s have brought the world to our finger tips, we find out how mobile apps are changing our daily lives.
UPSOUND DION CHANG 34:05:22
I think what makes a great app is just ease of use, you go directly to the app if it solves a problem and it creates a solution for you apps the better way to go.
